name: infra.compute.host.create
title: Create a host
description: Makes a host, and whatever it needs at the provider, under our resource id. A create with an id already made makes nothing and gives the host. It answers at once with the host creating; it becomes running later (host.get, or the host.changed event).

id.description: Our resource id for the host, the idempotency key, e.g. west-general-1

name.description: Its name at the provider; the id when left out

image.description: An image id from image.list; the provider's default Ubuntu when left out

userData.description: Cloud-init user data run at first boot

nested.description: Whether it must run virtual machines: only sizes with vms are accepted
